explication: Obsidian Mind is a vault-based persistent memory system for coding agents. The principal workflow starts with an agent session loading goals, active work, and memories; conversations and commands capture work into linked vault notes, while review and wrap-up commands organize evidence and surface wins. The README also documents incident capture, people context, and optional QMD semantic retrieval through CLI and MCP. Source excerpts were unavailable, so relationships below are limited to README-documented behavior.
